_comment: Your skills 'kit' — the single base for BOTH scoring and Discovery. It is DERIVED from your profile: build your profile (onboarding, Settings → Profile, or the jobcut-profile skill / a CV) and this file is written for you, so it fits your field — a designer, PM, nurse, teacher or analyst all get their own skills, categories and role_segments. It ships EMPTY on purpose (no field bias). Shape, once populated: 'skills' maps a skill name to { cat (any category natural to your field), status: have|partial|gap, close_via: course|portfolio|cv-reframe|skip, patterns: [case-insensitive regex against job title+description] }. 'role_segments' map a job title to one of your target segments for the market report. You may also hand-edit this file; a re-derive MERGES and keeps your edits.
